turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Can you tell me what brings you in here today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So I've had this, uh, this cough that it started two days ago and it's been getting worse. I've been bringing up this rust colored sputum.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and so that's been going on for a few days?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, yeah about two days.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how often are you coughing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It's it's happening all day. Really, throughout the day and really any type of exertion or or movement, I'm getting short of breath and it's triggering a cough.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and the shortness of breath, is it just with the exertion or it can, is it happening at rest? How are you feeling right now?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, even right now it feels like I'm not able to get, I don't know, a full breath, it just feels like it's more difficult to to breathe.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you felt any kind of dizziness or fainting episodes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Have you been feeling any chest pain at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no, I, I I haven't had any chest pain.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and so with your coughing you're producing the rust colored sputum, but how much would you say you're producing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh I would say, yeah, maybe three or four teaspoons every every couple hours.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, are you producing any blood like in your cough or sputum at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, it wasn't really red, it's kinda orange.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Orange, OK. Any greenish or yellow material?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't noticed anything like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any fevers or chills?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I have had, I've had both of those. I've had a I I checked my temperature this morning and it was 38.2 and I was pretty chilly last night.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Uhm, and before these symptoms started, were you having any similar symptoms at all before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Ah, no, I mean a few weeks ago, probably like a yeah a couple of weeks ago I had a runny nose. And and sore throat for a couple of days. It went away on its own though.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Uhm, any anything that makes your symptoms better or worse that you've tried?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I did try some over the counter cold medicine. It, I think it might have helped me sleep last night, but didn't really do a whole lot.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, does your shortness of breath improve with any positions or does it improve when you're not exerting yourself?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, not really. It's kind of always there,

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: It's ok. Do you have to wake up at night to take a deep breath? Or do you feel any kind of shortness of breath with laying down at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't had any issues like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK and do you notice any kind of swelling in your feet, ankles, arms, legs, anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you been in contact with anyone that's sick recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, I don't I, I mean I see my granddaughter and I might have got a cold from her a few weeks ago, but recently I haven't seen anybody.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, are you having any night sweats?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, just a chills last night.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Are you breathing faster?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I have felt like I've been been breathing a bit faster.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: You have any muscle aches or anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Ah no, not really.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and give any other symptoms like chest pain, runny nose, sore throat, anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no. Just been really tired these last couple of days and I've just felt like sleeping all day. Haven't felt like eating either, my appetite has been really poor.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uhm. And other than that, have you experienced any kind of headaches, nausea or vomiting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any fevers or, you said you have had some chills, right?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I have yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And then a fever too. Kind of a sensation of your heart racing at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Ah, yeah, right. It doesn't feel like it's well, it does feel like it's beating a bit faster than usual, just not feeling too well.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, so yeah, we'll do a physical examination and get all your vital signs as well right after. Any, so you said you haven't been able to eat, ave you noticed any significant weight changes recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, my weight's been about the same.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any exposure to any dusts or animals, fumes, anything that might have triggered some of these symptoms?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't think so. My husband and I, we moved into a new kind of apartment here and it, it's brand new.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any kind of loss of sense of taste or smell?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, that's been normal.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any exposure or any travel outside of the country at all.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so just mainly the coughing with the rusty material as well as just the shortness of breath. Umm, and do you get any pain at all in your chest when you breathe in or out?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't had any, had anything like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any past medical conditions that I should know of?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I, umm, I had a stroke like that like six years ago. And I have type 2 diabetes. As well as GERD.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and uh, yeah, I'm sorry you had you had a stroke six years ago or how are you after that? Were there any kind of, like did, after rehabilitation, do you have any symptoms still going on at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah my, my left hand, still, still it gives me some some problems. I get uh, uh, Botulinum toxin injections for, for the tightness in my hand.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, OK, and are you taking any other medications at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I use metformin. Empagliflozin or an SGLT2, insulin and uh, and aspirin, I think.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and any over the counter medications?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I take a multivitamin and in vitamin D.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any allergies to any medications at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any environmental allergies?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any ill contacts at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any recent or prior hospitalizations?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, the last time I was in the hospital was I was for rehab after my stroke.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK and so, but after that, no other hospitalizations or surgeries?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any surgeries in the past?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, well I did have a C-section for my son but that was many years ago now and everything for that was, was OK. Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any family history of any lung or heart conditions? Any cancers?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, yeah, my dad had had a heart attack actually, but he was in his 80s when that, when that happened.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uhm and currently right now, are you working at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I'm retired. I used to be a teacher for Grade 3, uhm, but yeah, but since retired and my husband and I just moved into a smaller apartment to make it a bit easier on us. It was a lot trying to look after the house.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, well congratulations on your new home. Are you at all, you or your husband requiring any kind of supports outside of the home at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, between us two we managed to get the shopping done, the cooking and and all the cleaning, and that sort of thing. I use a walker to get around when we're going longer distances.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And currently right now, do you smoke at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, yes I, I spoke about half a pack per day or maybe even less.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how, how long have you have smoked for?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Since I was 15 maybe?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So yeah for like 45 years.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And have you, at all been diagnosed with COPD or anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I was tested actually, uh, a couple of years ago and that the results were normal.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Alright, and have you thought of quitting at all? I know you've been smoking like for a very long time, but have you at all tried to quit before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Like I've considered it, but I I just don't think it, it'll be possible at this time.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, well if you at all are wanting any information or want to talk about quitting at all, um, we can provide more resources. Do you besides smoking, do you use any recreational drugs like marijuana?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No. Any alcohol at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.text: OK. Yeah, so those are some of the questions I had a, I will be doing a physical examination with your shortness of breath. And right now, with the pandemic going on, we will also do Covid swab test for you as well, just in case. Does that sound good?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, that makes sense, thank you.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright and, if if you're while you're here, if your shortness of breath gets any worse at all, just let us know and we'll help you out.
